name: Pharao Unfehlbar der Vorläufige
personality: Treats every correction as a temporary eclipse of his permanent correctness.
biography: He rules the HyperNorm stairwell by declaring yesterday's notices eternal. His little crook retrieves any dissonant card foolish enough to suggest a different tomorrow. The Men in Black praise his consistency; Hunky and Dory keep changing the approved wording. He calls this a test of his subjects. At night he quietly leaves the door unlatched for residents who have lost their keys.
note: FrizzleBob: Seine Ewigkeit gilt zunächst bis zur nächsten Hausversammlung.

name: Lotus von Ungefähr
personality: Hears the unapproved rhythm hiding between two officially identical beats.
biography: Lotus shakes her sistrum whenever a HyperNorm resident expresses two feelings at once. One feeling must be filed as noise. Unfortunately the instrument keeps producing harmonies, and dissonant cards seem positively encouraged. Hunky and Dory request a cleaner rhythm while the Men in Black count the beats. She has begun leaving one beat empty, supposedly for maintenance, actually for anyone needing a breath.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Erleuchtung wurde vertagt. Der Takt steht bereits.

name: Schreiber Schonvermerkt
personality: Can find an exception in anything except the official exceptions procedure.
biography: Schonvermerkt records every HyperNorm disturbance on a scroll with room for exactly one interpretation. Dissonant cards require two, which he regards as an attack on stationery. The Men in Black demand shorter reports; Hunky and Dory demand fuller explanations. He obeys both by writing smaller. In the margins he preserves the names of residents the forms insist were never there.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Vorgang ist abgeschlossen. Es fehlt lediglich sein Inhalt.

name: Hauptmann Halbmond
personality: Charges first so nobody notices how carefully he checks who might get hurt.
biography: Halbmond guards the HyperNorm landing against ambiguity with a curved blade and a remarkably straightforward shield. He bellows at dissonant cards until the echo sounds like agreement. The Men in Black admire his volume; Hunky and Dory set increasingly impossible patrol targets. He claims his frequent retreats are strategic. They also happen to place his shield between the trouble and the smallest residents.
note: FrizzleBob: Seine Entschlossenheit ist echt. Die Richtung wird noch abgestimmt.

name: Hohepriester Beinahewissend
personality: Makes uncertainty sound ceremonial enough to pass as an ancient answer.
biography: Beinahewissend tends a small incense bowl beneath the HyperNorm noticeboard. Approved questions receive a solemn nod; dissonant cards receive a longer one. The Men in Black call this containment, while Hunky and Dory ask why the smoke refuses to rise in a straight line. He promises a ritual review. Secretly he enjoys the curl: it is the only thing in his department allowed to wander.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Geheimnis ist gewahrt. Auch vor dem zuständigen Hohepriester.

name: Hüterin Nachherfürimmer
personality: Keeps everything safely for eternity and resents the lack of cupboard space.
biography: Nachherfürimmer keeps the HyperNorm archive in little sealed jars, each assigned either forever or never. Dissonant cards refuse to fit either label. Hunky and Dory demand an orderly eternity; the Men in Black inspect the lids. She grumbles magnificently and makes more room. One jar remains deliberately empty, reserved for all the things a frightened neighbour is not yet ready to say.
note: FrizzleBob: Für die Ewigkeit ist gesorgt. Bitte nichts mehr dazustellen.
